done.issue: major, rps7200/library.py:971: _holds_the_decode let zlib.error from a truncated compressed TIFF escape, so verify, prunable and compact's pre-check crashed on real damage
done.change: ddadafc: _holds_the_decode now treats any exception from the read or the decode as 'not the decode', which counts as damage. New parametrised test test_a_scan_tif_that_will_not_read_is_reported_not_raised covers a truncated compressed scan.tif beside raw.bin and beside an unnamed scan.before-migrate-raw.tif. It checks that verify says 'does not match its checksum' and that compact raises OSError. Without the fix it fails with zlib.error.

done.issue: major, rps7200/library.py:545: a no-raw compaction killed between the TIFF swap and the record write was reported as damaged for good, and a second compact returned False
done.change: 9383e58: compact now writes every TIFF beside first (synced) and records their checksums in scan.json under library.COMPACTING before swapping any in. The final record takes those checksums and drops the note. damage() (through _stopped_rewrite and a new _compacted_to) reports a TIFF matching the note as 'compaction stopped part way'. compact's pre-check accepts it, and compact runs again while the note is present even when nothing is uncompressed. The decode-based proof stays for entries stopped by the older code. The test helper _compact_cut_short_after_the_swaps now lets the note write through and kills only the final record. New test test_a_plain_entry_without_bytes_cut_short_is_not_damage fails without the fix with both checksum errors.
